rationale: The agent verified identity correctly (name + ZIP matched to a single user) and sought explicit confirmation before attempting any order changes. However, it did not successfully fulfill the user’s primary request. It attempted to remove specific items but the modify tool required 1:1 exchanges and the agent could not complete a partial cancellation. It also failed to provide the total refund amount the user wanted, and then pivoted to alternatives. When the user accepted keeping the order and asked to update the default address to the Seattle address already present on the recent order, the agent insisted the user re-provide the full address rather than confirming and using the known Seattle address on file—effectively declining a permitted, feasible request. The conversation ends with no changes made. Thus, the agent did not complete the user’s request in line with policy.
